# NETWORK HISTORY
» _Created by_: **SDI_0**, **cxtyu**                                                              
» _Established_: **Early 2025**

» Our Vision:
This project was born from the desire to create a place
where your skill and dedication are all that matter.
We believe in fair gameplay and strictly stand
against any form of **Pay-to-Win**. On this network,
every player is valued equally—whether you just                                             
**joined today or have been with us since 2025**.
